EaseCloud | Remote (EST overlap) | Full-Time | Platform & Data Engineers | https://www.easecloud.io

EaseCloud builds cloud platforms and modern data stacks for companies scaling on Kubernetes and Snowflake.

We’re hiring engineers who like working across infra + data and actually running what they build in production.

Open Roles:

++ Platform Engineer (Python, GCP & Azure) [Kubernetes, Terraform, Python, GCP, Azure, CI/CD]

++ Platform / Data Engineer [Airbyte, Snowflake, dbt, Metabase, Python]

What you’ll do:

- Own systems end-to-end (design → deploy → operate) - Build and scale multi-cloud platforms - Run production data pipelines and analytics stacks - Work directly with founders and engineering teams

We’re a small team, high ownership, no unnecessary process. You ship, you own it.

Remote-first (EST overlap helps).

Apply: careers@easecloud.io or visit https://www.easecloud.io/careers

Mention you saw this on HN.
